entries.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic casting master portrait, waist-up landscape 16:9, of a wholly fictional Filipino woman coffee founder about 39, with an individually memorable, ordinary believable face. Fresh casting, not a stock AI influencer or polished generic model: softly square face, broad cheekbones, slightly asymmetric natural eyebrows with the left arch a little higher, deep-set dark brown eyes, a broad natural nose with softly rounded tip, a defined slightly off-center cupid's bow, a small healed mark near one eyebrow, real subtle under-eye lines and sun freckles, warm medium-tan skin with visible pores. Short dark wavy bob ending around the jaw, loosely tucked behind one ear, practical and slightly unruly. Her expression is focused, observant and quietly confident, lips relaxed closed, not smiling for a commercial. She looks up briefly from checking a blank paper packing slip at her coffee work counter. She wears a rich petrol-teal cotton work shirt with rolled sleeves and a rust-red canvas waist apron; no jewelry except plain small studs. Both full hands rest separately on a warm wood counter, hands comfortably inside the frame. A cared-for modest Filipino coffee business workspace: kraft bags, coffee jars, practical shelves, an open doorway to saturated green tropical plants, blue sky and white clouds. MASTER DAYLIGHT: bright colorful tropical day outdoors, soft even open-shade light on entire face and body, neutral white balance, rich natural colors, no harsh patches of sun, no gray wash, no golden face cast, no rim light, no glam retouch. Natural face and body proportions, no caricature, no exoticized styling, no real person likeness. Give comfortable head and hand margins. No bottle yet, no readable text, no logos, no interface, no graphic captions. High-end candid documentary photograph, 50mm equivalent camera, eye-level.
